names: CONTINUOUS OUTPUT POWER AND POWER FACTOR
rules.basis: The PST, PSE and SAM sheets print the continuous rating in watts under these names, 1000 W for the PST-1000-12 and 'Maximum Continuous Active Power Output' on the PSE sheet; the EVO sheets print theirs in VA under the shared names and read as gaps. The EVO-1212F, EVO-1224F and EVO-4248SP manuals print the continuous rating in watts with the power factor on the same line, '1200 Watt at PF = 0.95', which the parser refuses, so the figure is named and the gap says so.

The PSE-12275A sheet states the unit's output as 2750 W under 'AC power output' and 'Ac output power'; the 1500 W it prints for the NEMA 5-15R receptacle is one outlet's share, named as such, and is not read.

The PST sheets print 'SURGE' beside 'OUTPUT POWER', 2000 W against 1000 W, and the PSE sheet 'Maximum Active Surge Power Output'; none states a time, so each is a gap until one is printed. The NTX and SAM lines that say the surge holds for less than a second are not read: no condition can state a bound, and reading '1 SEC' off the name would overstate what the sheet says.

names: NO LOAD POWER CONSUMPTION IN NORMAL MODE (120 VAC OUTPUT, TYPICAL)
rules.basis: The EVO sheets state the no-load draw in normal mode, which is inverting.

names: NO LOAD POWER CONSUMPTION IN POWER SAVING MODE
rules.basis: The EVO sheets state the no-load draw in power saving mode, as a bound, which is refused until a figure is printed.

names: NO LOAD POWER CONSUMPTION IN STANDBY MODE
rules.basis: The EVO sheets state the no-load draw in standby mode; the mode is in the name.

The SEC-1250UL and SEC-2425UL sheets state the bulk stage current capacity, 50 and 25 A, beside a lower set value; the SCC sheets state the maximum charging current in full power mode. The EVO's 'BULK CURRENT' is a setting below its rated charging current, and the SEC-BRM's 'CONTINUOUS OUTPUT CURRENT' is its load output, not the 8 A it charges a battery with, so neither is read.
The catalogue page for the EVO-30AB and SCC-30AB states their charging capacity, 30 A.
The EVO-30AB manual states the controller's maximum continuous current, 30 A, its charge current; the bare name is read from that manual only.
The SCC-30AB manual states the controller's maximum continuous current, 30 A, its charge current; the bare name is read from that manual only.

names: Max. Open Circuit Voltage (VOC) of Solar Panel / Array
MAXIMUM OPEN CIRCUIT VOLTAGE (Voc) OF SOLAR PANEL / ARRAY
rules.basis: The EVO-30AB and SCC-30AB sheets and manuals state the array's open-circuit limit, 50 V, under both spellings.

names: MAXIMUM SHORT CIRCUIT CURRENT (Isc) OF SOLAR PANEL /ARRAY
rules.basis: The EVO-30AB and SCC-30AB sheets state the array's short-circuit limit, 30 A.
